idea: Signs of a hidden water leak
title: Detecting Hidden Plumbing Leaks with the Water Meter Test
description: A hidden water supply leak can waste thousands of liters before damp spots appear on walls or floors. To quickly verify an unseen leak without opening walls, perform a static meter check. Close every faucet, toilet valve, and water-using appliance in the building. Locate your main mechanical water meter and examine the dial face. Most meters feature a small triangular or star-shaped low-flow indicator. If this wheel rotates while every fixture is shut, water is actively escaping from your pressurized pipe network. This simple diagnostic confirms whether a hidden leak exists before pursuing acoustic tracing or thermal imaging.
image_prompt: A crisp, photorealistic, vertical 9:16 close-up photograph of a brass mechanical water meter installed along a clean residential supply line. The meter face is protected by clear glass, showing a white dial with black numerical registers and a prominent red low-flow leak indicator wheel in the center. Modern copper supply pipes connect to the meter with threaded brass unions. Bright, natural directional lighting highlights the textured metal and clear dial face. Clean composition with natural shadow and empty space at the top and bottom third for text overlay placement. Professional plumbing installation setting, vertical orientation, photorealistic details, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no digital graphic overlays.
visual_story: The visual provides a detailed, clear view of a mechanical water meter's dial face, focusing on the small low-flow indicator wheel. By showing the exact physical component used to detect small flows, the visual teaches viewers precisely where to look on their own equipment to verify if water is continuously flowing through a closed system.

on_image_text.hook: How to Spot a Hidden Water Leak
on_image_text.explanation: When all house fixtures are closed, the leak indicator wheel on your water meter should remain completely stationary.
on_image_text.takeaway: A spinning dial with all valves shut confirms an active supply line leak.
